title: Surreal Cosmic Buddha
description: A vibrant surreal scene featuring a glowing Buddha statue standing on a large luminous lotus flower in the foreground. To the upper left is an abstract orange and teal face motif, while a giant green cartoonish monster with large eyes and red spots looms from the top center. A bright multicolored light burst radiates from the center, with a brown horse standing in a pink-dotted field in the upper right and a small boat on turbulent dark waves in the lower right.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal psychedelic composition with a golden Buddha statue standing serenely on a glowing lotus flower in the lower center. A giant green cartoon monster with big eyes and teeth looms from the top. An abstract orange and teal stylized face appears on the left. A brown horse stands in a field of pink flowers in the upper right. A small boat sails on turbulent dark blue waves in the lower right. Bright rainbow light explosion in the center with colorful orbs and paint drips, cosmic green planets in the background, vibrant and chaotic atmosphere.
